description: NaLi₂NiCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.92 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.13 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 62-82°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.16 Å. Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.23 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.28-1.30 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NiO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-56°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.55 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Li, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Ni, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Ni, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaLiNiC trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, one Ni, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Ni, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing OLi₂NiP trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Ni, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Ni, and one P atom.
